title_vi: Làm tốt phỏng vấn thiết kế hệ thống: bảy bước

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body independently hashed as Git blob; computed OID matches provider tree OID. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Bài tài liệu ôn phỏng vấn nhắc luyện khung bảy bước ở mảng thiết kế hệ thống.

claims.evidence: The seven steps come from the source; the four-step comparison was read in the README of donnemartin/system-design-primer (local clone). These are practitioner frameworks, with no standard to check against.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson at each width with optional sections open; diagram scale measured from the rendered image and every SVG text box checked against the viewBox. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: A seven-step approach: clarify requirements, estimate capacity, high-level design, database design, interface design, scalability and performance, reliability and resiliency.
claims.verified_by: Source body read; a practitioner framework, not independently verifiable.

claims.claim_vi: System Design Primer proposes four steps: outline use cases, constraints and assumptions; create a high-level design; design core components; scale the design.
claims.section: How to approach a system design interview question
claims.verified_by: README read from a local clone.

design_notes_vi: Mỗi bước là một câu hỏi để dễ nhớ; ghi chú nói đây là bản đồ, không phải kịch bản. Bài không đưa con số mẫu nào. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source presents the seven steps as the process to follow; the lesson presents them as one map among several, notes that order can change, and compares with a four-step framework.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
